blocks.title: Digital entrepreneurship
blocks.text: Digital entrepreneurship technology aur online platforms (Internet, social media, e-commerce aur digital tools) se karobari khayalat aur khidmat banana, chalana aur barhana hai.

Digital entrepreneurs jiddat wale digital hal se haqeeqi masail hal karte aur duniya bhar ke gahakon tak pohanchne ke liye social media, e-commerce websites aur freelancing platforms use karte hain. Jiddat, yani badalti market ki zarooraton ke liye naye products aur khidmat banana, markazi hai, aur yeh shoba talaba ko takhleeqi khayalat ko kaamyab karobar mein badalne deta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Zyada tar kaamyab entrepreneurs paidaishi khatra uthane wale nahi hote; woh tajurbe se khatra uthane ki maharat seekhte hain.
Kaamyab entrepreneurs aur Pakistan ki digital maeeshat

items: Takhleeqi: masail hal karne ke naye khayalat ki talash mein.
Mehnati aur apne maqasid se wabasta.
Pur-aitmad aur soche samjhe khatre uthane ko tayyar.
Faislon aur masla hal karne mein mazboot.
Badalti market aur gahakon ki zarooraton ke mutabiq dhalne wale.

blocks.text: Internet aur mobile phones tak barhti rasai se Pakistan mein entrepreneurship tezi se barh rahi hai. Bohat se naujawan social media, e-commerce aur freelancing se online karobar shuru karte hain; digital maeeshat software development, digital marketing aur online khidmat mein naukriyan paida karti hai; aur sarkari aur nijji iqdamat startups ki madad karte, naujawanon ko naukri dhoondne ke bajaye naukri dene wala banne mein madad dete hain.
Mauqe dhoondna aur masail hal karna

Karobari mauqa muashre ka aisa masla hai jo koi product ya khidmat hal kar sake. Entrepreneurs gahakon ki zarooratein aur market ki talab samajhne ke liye rozmarra zindagi dekhte, rawaiye, pasand aur rujhanat parhte, aur market ke khala dhoondne ke liye surveys, raye aur online data use karte hain. Technology taleem, sehat, zara'at aur karobar mein mauqe kholti hai (Fig 9.4): online parhai talaba ko ghar se parhne deti, mobile apps kisanon ki faslein behtar karti, aur digital payments lain-dain asan aur mehfooz banati hain.

blocks.caption: Digital karobar ke platforms (Fig 9.5)
rows: Products ki tashheer aur bari tadaad tak jaldi rasai
Dukaan ke baghair online maal aur khidmat bechna, kam kharche aur bari market
Graphic design, likhai, programming aur digital marketing jaisi maharatein kaheen bhi clients ko, lachakdar, azad aamdani

blocks.alt: Oopar baen technology par mabni hal: e-learning (taleem), telemedicine (sehat), smart farming (zara'at) aur digital payments (karobar). Oopar daen digital platforms: social media (Facebook, Instagram: tashheer), e-commerce (Daraz, Amazon: online farokht) aur freelancing (Fiverr, Upwork: maharatein bechna). Neeche khayal se launch tak mansooba bandi ke chhe jure qadam.
blocks.caption: Technology par mabni hal, digital platforms aur karobari mansooba (Figs 9.4 aur 9.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chhota digital karobar aik platform, maslan Instagram page, se shuru ho kar barhne ke saath doosre shamil kar sakta hai.

blocks.text: Chhote digital karobar ki mansooba bandi

items: Aisa product ya khidmat chunein jo gahak ki haqeeqi zaroorat poori kare.
Target sameen, qeemat aur digital platforms se delivery ka tareeqa tay karein.
Wazeh maqasid aur darkar wasail ki mansooba bandi: waqt, paisa aur maharat.
Qeemat tay karne aur kharcha sambhalne ke liye kharchon aur mutawaqqa aamdani ka bunyadi budget.
Team banayein aur meetings, messaging apps aur online tools se achha rabta rakhein.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Zyada tar nakam startups ke paas wazeh mansooba nahi hota.

Achhi budget-bandi aur wasail ka intizam paisa, waqt aur maharat ko zaya kiye baghair use karta, karobar ko munafa-bakhsh rakhta aur taveel kaamyabi mein madad deta hai; mazboot team work aur rabta startups mein paidawar barhate hain.

Jiddat ka matlab naye ya behtar khayalat, products ya khidmat banana hai jo masail behtar tareeqe se hal karein, aur yeh digital karobar ko muqable mein rakhti hai. AI, cloud computing, blockchain aur mobile apps jaisi ubharti technologies entrepreneurs ko aalmi rasai wale zyada zaheen, tez aur saste hal banane deti hain. AI data aur gahakon ka rawaiya parakhne aur faisle behtar karne mein madad deti; mobile apps gahakon tak pohanchti aur jaldi products bechti; aur online payments, cloud storage aur marketing tools jaisi digital khidmat kharche kam karti hain.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: AI tools ab design, likhai aur karobar chalane mein madad tak kar sakte hain.

Technology entrepreneurship ke career mein startup ki bunyad rakhna, programming, graphic design ya digital marketing mein freelancing, app development, e-commerce ka intizam, online mashawarat, aur haqeeqi masail ke naye digital hal banane wala mujtahid banna shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Apne ilaqe ke liye chhote digital karobar ka khayal banayein: zaroorat, gahak, platform aur aik kharcha batayein.
blocks.explanation: Maslan: waqt ki kami wale daftari mulazimeen ke liye ghar ke bane lunch box (zaroorat); gahak qareeb ke daftaron ka amla; orders WhatsApp Business page se aur tashheer Instagram par (platform); kharchon mein ajza aur motorcycle se delivery. (In chaar hisson wala koi bhi munasib mansooba durust hai.)

items: Digital entrepreneurship: karobar banane aur barhane ke liye online platforms.
Haqeeqi zarooratein dhoondein; social media, e-commerce aur freelancing platforms.
Mansooba: product, gahak, qeemat, budget, team; AI, apps aur digital khidmat se jiddat.
